components.name: BaseFixture
components.label: Base · M8 table mounting plate
components.explanation: Anchors the arm to a rigid bench. Four 9 mm clearance holes on 180 mm PCD; rear service port; central cable passage. Anchoring, mass and bolt selection require structural validation.

components.name: BaseAccent
components.label: Base · removable trim ring
components.explanation: Visual trim and cover seam around the waist stage. Does not carry the arm load.

components.name: WaistHousing
components.label: J1 · waist actuator enclosure
components.explanation: Rotating waist enclosure and central cable route. Its local Z axis follows the first arm joint; bearing and actuator interfaces remain conceptual.

components.name: ShoulderYokeL
components.label: J2 · shoulder yoke L
components.explanation: Support cheek for shoulder pivot. Bore is a placeholder for a bearing-supported output shaft; bearing seat tolerance must be designed.

components.name: ShoulderYokeR
components.label: J2 · shoulder yoke R
components.explanation: Support cheek for shoulder pivot. Bore is a placeholder for a bearing-supported output shaft; bearing seat tolerance must be designed.

components.name: upperShell
components.label: Upper arm · hollow structural shell
components.explanation: 300 mm pivot spacing. Hollow concept housing with 16 mm pivot passages and a front service recess. Wall sizing and torque load paths require analysis.

components.name: upperCover
components.label: Upper arm · service cover
components.explanation: Removable front cover identifies cable and actuator service area. Fasteners, cable strain relief and a complete tendon spool package are not yet detailed.

components.name: upperRootBearingCover
components.label: Upper arm · root bearing cover
components.explanation: External bearing cover and joint-axis marker. The orange bore ring is a visual reference, not a selected commercial bearing.

components.name: upperRootHubRing
components.label: Upper arm · root hub ring
components.explanation: High-contrast marker makes the simulated hinge axis visible when inspecting the mechanism.

components.name: upperTipBearingCover
components.label: Upper arm · tip bearing cover
components.explanation: External bearing cover and joint-axis marker. The orange bore ring is a visual reference, not a selected commercial bearing.

components.name: upperTipHubRing

components.explanation: High-contrast marker makes the simulated hinge axis visible when inspecting the mechanism.

components.name: WristPitchHousing
components.label: J4 · wrist pitch housing
components.explanation: 60 mm wrist stage. Pitch follows the local Y axis; a through-bore reserves cable space for the hand.

components.name: WristRollCollar
components.label: J5 · wrist roll collar
components.explanation: Visual collar at the hand roll interface. Rotation is around the palm Z axis; a slip ring and cable turn limit must be resolved for physical construction.

components.name: PalmShell
components.label: Palm · 100 × 84 × 32 mm shell
components.explanation: Adult-scale palm with dorsal access, screw bosses and wrist cable inlet. The 100 mm palm plus 90 mm middle finger establishes the 190 mm hand scale.

components.name: PalmDorsalLid
components.label: Palm · removable dorsal cover
components.explanation: Dorsal service lid. Four M3 clearance holes align with internal bosses; threaded inserts and screw lengths need selection.

components.name: PalmContactPad
components.label: Palm · compliant contact pad concept
components.explanation: Reserved palmar contact surface. Simulation uses idealized friction; elastomer durometer, attachment and tactile sensing are unvalidated.

components.name: index_knuckleYoke
components.label: index knuckle · lateral joint
components.explanation: Base axis enables finger spread or thumb opposition. The crossing-axis articulation is kinematically modeled; a complete miniature bearing and transmission package remains to be engineered.

components.name: index_proximalBody
components.label: index proximal · 40 mm
components.explanation: 40 mm joint spacing / tip length; 2.1 mm hinge bores, 1.4 mm tendon guide bores, root tongue and distal clevis where applicable. Cable routing around moving joints and fatigue behavior are not verified.

components.name: index_proximalPin
components.label: index proximal · hinge pin
components.explanation: Nominal 1.96 mm pin reference for the 2.1 mm CAD bore. Actual pin tolerance, retention and bearing wear need physical testing.
